claim.en: A 2007 Hospodárske noviny profile describes František Gahér (born 1957) as a philosophy and physics graduate of Comenius University who worked there throughout his career and was then in his second term as its rector.
claim.sk: Profil Hospodárskych novín z roku 2007 opisuje Františka Gahéra (nar. 1957) ako absolventa filozofie a fyziky na UK, ktorý na nej pôsobil a vtedy bol v druhom funkčnom období rektorom.

findings.identity: Former rector of Comenius University, born 1957 (so 69 in 2026), professor of philosophy/logic; matches candidate prof. PhDr. František Gahér, CSc., 69, university teacher, and a councillor of Svätý Jur of the same name per SME 2022 results
findings.quote: František Gahér Narodil sa 20. januára 1957 v Trnave. Vyštudoval filozofiu a fyziku na Univerzite Komenského v Bratislave. … v súčasnosti ako rektor v druhom funkčnom období.
findings.title: Profil: František Gahér
